description: Animated trials only (campaigns taille-1, taille-2, taille-3): set the pose of some parts at one frame (frames 1 to max_frames of the commission: 16, 32 or 48; 0.25 s apart), or at several frames in one call with frames. A part keeps its last pose until moved again. moves = {part_id: {position?, rotation?}}.

frames.description: Several frames at once instead of frame + moves: {"12": {moves}, "13": {moves}}

name: forge_keyframe
